title: Add JMAP Metadata notes to Message, Chat, and Space sections
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00, add informative notes (similar to existing Space/RFC9670 and Space/FileNode notes) in the Message, Chat, and Space sections: implementations MAY support the JMAP Metadata extension (draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-01) for private client-side annotations on these objects, using objectType values 'Message', 'Chat', and 'Space'. Use cases: per-message bookmarks, per-chat color tags, per-Space custom labels. No new spec required.
